learning_outcomes.text: The student, in line with the objectives of the course, will develop skills related to programming languages.
The student will learn the architecture of computers.
The student will learn a programming language.
The student will learn computer networks.
The student, at the end of the course, will know the theoretical and practical concepts about programming languages, computer architecture and computer networks.
The student will be able to design, through the use of a programming language, algorithmic solutions to simple problems also in biomedical field.
The students will be able to solve a problem in a different way than they already did during the lessons.
The student will be able to describe a solution to a specific problem with sufficient level of formalism and appropriate languages.
The student will be able to evaluate different strategies and choose the most suitable solution in specific situations, while being aware of the limitations and strengths of the selected solutions.

syllabus_topics: C Language. Primitive Data. Type and symbolic constants. input e output operations. Flow control (conditional and iterative). Array e Matrix. Sorting and Searching Algorithms
Computer Network Introduction: physical interfaces, computer networks, main network services
assessment_rules: Students with a grade higher than 18/30 in the written test will have access to the oral examination. The oral examination consists of the discussion of the exercises solved during the written test. The final mark is the average of the marks obtained in the two tests.
